arbocensus.title: Arbocensus
arbocensus.context: Thesis project, Universidad de los Andes
arbocensus.description: Thesis project: route optimization for urban tree censuses. mTSP with OR-Tools, OSRM, Django + PostGIS and React
arbocensus.longDescription: Urban tree censuses require a team of surveyors to walk to thousands of trees spread across a municipality. Arbocensus models that route as an mTSP (multiple Traveling Salesman Problem): from the geometries stored in PostGIS, it computes the pedestrian cost matrix with OSRM and solves it with the OR-Tools VRP solver, running the optimization jobs in Celery. The React frontend displays the resulting routes on a Leaflet map.

scheduler.title: Scheduler App
scheduler.description: Schedule management and automatic group splitting with Flask
scheduler.longDescription: An app to coordinate availability within groups. Each member marks their free time blocks and the app finds the best moments to meet; it also splits the group automatically into compatible subgroups. Includes Google OAuth 2.0 authentication, Owner / Admin / Member roles, custom categories with AND / OR filters, and a dockerized deployment with PostgreSQL.

healthy.title: Healthy
healthy.description: Healthy meal plan recommendation system integrated with purchases
healthy.longDescription: A platform where companies publish meal plans with their nutritional information and users receive recommendations based on their preferences, customize the plan by answering questions, purchase it and track their deliveries. Includes per-plan reviews, roles with CanCanCan and authentication with Devise.
